svg.title: A Virtue Between Two Vices
svg.desc: Three rows of Aristotle's golden mean from the Nicomachean Ethics, in W. D. Ross's wording. Each virtue sits between a deficiency and an excess: cowardice, courage, rashness; meanness, liberality, prodigality; insensibility, temperance, self-indulgence.

text.font-family: 'Liberation Serif', 'Iowan Old Style', Palatino, Georgia, serif
'Liberation Serif', 'Iowan Old Style', Palatino, Georgia, serif

svg.text: The mean is relative to us, not a bland average. The names follow W. D. Ross’s translation of the Nicomachean Ethics.
